jobs.title: Director of Product, AI Growth
jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Product, the Director of Product, AI Growth grows 1Password's new business in artificial intelligence. In this role, you own driving growth for our AI opportunities by identifying which customers we target, which outcomes we win on, and proving it with design customers. You scale growth through our go-to-market organization and through partnerships with the agent ecosystem and channel partners.

How We’re Using AI Today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

Minimum of 8 years of product management experience, including experience carrying a revenue or adoption target, with a preference for experience in security products, agentic products, or developer tools.
Experience owning the strategy for a new product area or market entry, and taking it from hypothesis to customers running in production.
Experience working directly with enterprise customers on a technical deployment, as the person accountable for the outcome, and turning what those deployments proved into a repeatable motion a sales team can run.
Experience building technology partnerships and integrations, including judging where a product should sit in a larger technology ecosystem and working with business development on commercial terms.
Technical depth to hold a credible conversation with developers and security architects about how AI agents are built, deployed, and given access to systems.
Demonstrated ability to build alignment across go-to-market and engineering teams toward a shared goal, without direct authority over either.
Demonstrated ability to make decisions and move work forward with incomplete information in a fast-changing market.
Takes ownership end to end, including the work that falls between teams.
Works AI-first: uses agents in daily work, and applies their own judgement to decisions, product taste, and customer and internal relationships.
Preferred: familiarity with agentic access products, meaning the products that give AI agents credentials and access to the systems they work in.

What You Can Expect

Growth strategy

Own the growth thesis for 1Password's AI opportunities, covering the customer segments we target, the outcomes we deliver that we win on, and the workflows we get embedded into. Revise it as evidence arrives from customers, partners, and the market.
Form and test hypotheses using customer feedback, product usage data, partner input, and market research gathered with the go-to-market, product, user experience, and product marketing teams.
Lead a weekly business review that brings the voice of the customer, field feedback, and product usage telemetry into one view, so the team can refine targets, forecast the roadmap's impact on growth, and prioritize the blockers that hold adoption back.
Identify what stops customers from adopting, and drive each blocker to a resolution with the product team that owns it.

Design customer program

Run the design customer program for new artificial intelligence opportunities, from selecting customers through to delivered outcomes.
Act as the general contractor for each design customer: the single person accountable for getting that customer deployed on 1Password for their agentic access, and for delivering the security and convenience outcomes they came for. Coordinate every team the deployment touches, and build what it requires together with a forward deployed engineering team.
Bring in solutions engineering, customer success, and product managers to help each customer reach their goal, and run feature betas with the product managers who own those features.
Turn what the program proves into the repeatable signal the company needs to scale, meaning the customer evidence, the deployment pattern, and the measured outcomes that the go-to-market and channel teams build sales plays on.
Improve the program each cycle so it reaches more design customers, raises delivery success rates and customer satisfaction, and shortens the time it takes the company to commercialize a new product.

Partnerships

Decide where 1Password should play in the customer's artificial intelligence stack to deliver the most customer value in securing agent access. Agent access can be controlled at several points in that stack, so weigh those points and choose the ones that solve the most of the customer's problem, rather than the ones we fit into most easily. Base the call on how customers run AI today and on how the industry is evolving.
Identify and pursue the partnerships that let us play at those points and that complete an end-to-end customer outcome, meaning the outcome a customer cannot reach with 1Password alone.
Work with partners to deliver integrations, and find the patterns that let us repeat an integration across similar partners instead of building each one from scratch.
Work with the business development team to structure commercial relationships that grow both companies' business and deliver value to shared customers.

Scale through the field and the developer community

Work with product enablement to build demos and enablement content that the field and our channel partners can use without your involvement.
Work with developer relations to grow adoption organically among developers, through reference architectures, sample code, and open source contributions.

Travel

Travel to design customer sites, partner meetings, and industry events approximately 10 to 20% of a given year.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $238,000 USD and $357,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $208,000 CAD and $312,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

jobs.title: Managing Director, Head of Financial Engineering
jobs.description:
The Head of Financial Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the Financial Engineering function across Global Asset Management.

This leader will partner with investment, risk, client, operations and technology stakeholders to identify, prioritize, design and deliver advanced analytical tools, data solutions and decision-support capabilities that enhance investment outcomes, business effectiveness and client value.

The role combines deep technical expertise with strategic leadership, ensuring that analytics and technology investments are aligned to business priorities and delivered through scalable, sustainable solutions.

The incumbent will lead a team of quantitative, analytics and engineering professionals while acting as a senior advisor to business leaders on data, analytics, investment technology and innovation opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

Three years from now this leader has:

Built a recognized Financial Engineering function.
Established a clear intake and prioritization model.
Delivered investment analytics and portfolio intelligence capabilities.
Improved the speed and quality of business decision making.
Created stronger alignment between Investment teams, Technology and Data organizations.
Established a team capable of delivering sophisticated analytics solutions at scale.

Core Accountabilities

Financial Engineering Strategy

Define the vision, operating model and roadmap for Financial Engineering across GAM.
Develop a multi-year strategy for analytics, investment tooling and decision-support capabilities.
Identify opportunities to leverage data, quantitative methods, automation and emerging technologies to solve investment and business challenges.
Evaluate external trends and industry practices to identify competitive advantages.

Business Partnership

Serve as a strategic advisor to senior business leaders.
Partner with Portfolio Managers, Research teams, Product leaders, Distribution leaders and operational partners to understand strategic priorities.
Translate business opportunities into technology, data and analytics solutions.
Establish governance frameworks for intake, prioritization and delivery.

Analytics and Solution Development

Lead the design and delivery of portfolio analytics, risk analytics, attribution, performance measurement and decision-support tools.
Oversee development of advanced analytical frameworks and data products.
Guide evaluation and implementation of quantitative methodologies and emerging technologies.
Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable and aligned to enterprise architecture standards.

Portfolio Leadership

Lead a portfolio of strategic initiatives from concept through implementation.
Establish delivery roadmaps and execution plans.
Balance competing priorities across stakeholder groups.
Manage dependencies across business, data and technology teams.
Ensure realization of expected business outcomes.

People Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing Financial Engineering team.
Recruit, develop and retain quantitative, engineering and analytics talent.
Provide technical direction and coaching.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability and continuous improvement.
Establish standards, practices and methodologies for solution development.

Enterprise Influence

Develop trusted relationships with executives across GAM and enterprise partners.
Lead discussions involving complex technical and business concepts.
Influence investment and technology strategies through data-driven recommendations.
Represent GAM within enterprise analytics, technology and innovation forums.

Experience

Ideal Experience Profile

12-15+ years of progressive experience within Asset Management, Wealth Management, Capital Markets or Financial Services.
Experience leading analytics, quantitative, investment technology or financial engineering functions.
Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale data, analytics or technology capabilities.
Experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams.
Experience leading large transformation programs and strategic initiatives.
Extensive stakeholder management experience with executive leadership teams.

Technical Expertise

Strong understanding of:

Portfolio construction
Investment analytics
Performance attribution
Risk analytics
Market and security data
Data architecture
Cloud-based analytics environments
AI and machine learning applications
Software development lifecycle and product delivery methodologies

Leadership Capabilities

Strategic thinking
Executive presence
Enterprise influence
Organizational leadership
Program governance
Change leadership
Decision making under ambiguity
Complex stakeholder management

Salary:

$120,000.00 - $215,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

The above represents BMO Financial Group’s pay range and type.

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.bmo.com/global/en/Total-Rewards

About Us

At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. jobs.title: Director, Assisted Channels Platform Strategy, Resiliency & Organizational Change Management
jobs.description:
About The Role

This is a unique opportunity to shape the strategy, resiliency and employee experience of the assisted-channel platforms that enable Personal & Business Banking (P&BB) employees to serve customers. Working across Business, Technology, Product, Operations and Risk teams, the Director will turn employee, customer and performance insights into clear priorities, roadmaps and sustained outcomes.

P&BB depends on assisted-channel platforms that are reliable, intuitive and able to evolve with employee and customer needs. This role will define how those platforms advance over time, how resiliency priorities are established and how change is introduced and sustained across the frontline.

This is a strategic and execution-focused mandate. The role connects near-term stability and employee-experience needs with longer-term platform modernization, ensuring that incidents, operational insights, adoption results and frontline feedback influence priorities and investment decisions.

The Director leads three integrated functions: Assisted Channels Platform Strategy and Resiliency, Organizational Change Management for Digital Employee Platforms, and BTE.
The role establishes the strategies, governance, measures and partnerships needed to improve technology performance, employee readiness and frontline outcomes. Acting as a trusted advisor and integrator, this individual works with senior leaders and delivery partners to establish shared accountability, resolve cross-functional barriers and provide clear recommendations on priorities, risks, sequencing and investment.

Key Responsibilities (not limited to):

Assisted Channels Platform Strategy & Resiliency

Own and continuously evolve the vision, target state, multi-year strategy and roadmap for P&BB assisted-channel platforms.
Translate business strategy, employee and customer needs, technology health and operational risk into sequenced priorities, investment recommendations and measurable outcomes.

Organizational Change Management

Own the integrated organizational change management strategy and roadmap for Digital Employee Platforms and technology change affecting P&BB and other lines of business.
Provide oversight of stakeholder engagement, impact assessment, communications, learning, readiness, adoption, sustainment and benefits realization.

Branch Technology Experience

Lead the business approach to improving the technology experience for P&BB frontline employees, with a focus on stability, usability, productivity and customer service.
Establish a consistent model for issue intake, triage, escalation, communication and follow-through in partnership with Enterprise Technology and Operations.

Cross-Functional & People Leadership

Act as the connective tissue across P&BB, Product, Technology, Operations and Risk, creating shared accountability for platform, change and employee-experience outcomes.
Represent the mandate in senior governance forums and provide concise recommendations, trade-offs and decisions required.

Additional Details:

Provides subject matter expertise in the design, development, management and implementation of assigned projects from business case development through execution. Works across BMO to deliver specific project/program business results in alignment with overall group goals.

Fosters a culture aligned to BMO purpose, values and strategy and role models BMO values and behaviours in all that they do.
Ensures alignment between values and behaviour that fosters diversity and inclusion.
Regularly connects work to BMO’s purpose, sets inspirational goals, defines clear expected outcomes, and ensures clear accountability for follow through.
Builds interdependent teams that collaborate across functional and operating groups to create the highest value for all stakeholders.
Attracts, retains, and enables the career development of top talent.
Improves team performance, recognizes and rewards performance, coaches employees, supports their development, and manages poor performance.
Acts as a trusted advisor to senior leaders for making business decisions and implementing strategic initiatives.
Develops an expert understanding of business/group challenges.
Networks with industry contacts to gather competitive insights and best practices.
Recommends measures to improve organizational effectiveness.
May consult to or serve on various committees and task forces.
Manages resources and leads the execution of strategic initiatives to deliver on business and financial goals.
Interacts with various BMO groups to ensure strategy and initiatives meet enterprise governance requirements.
Leads implementation of strategic initiatives within group and across BMO by partnering with various internal & external stakeholders as required; complexity of initiatives may vary and usually involve multiple stakeholders across the enterprise.
Defines business requirements for analytics & reporting to ensure data insights inform business decision making.
Provides coaching on complex strategic & business issues and facilitates processes to reach effective resolution.
Assesses and adapts existing operational programs; develops new capabilities to ensure ongoing success.
Leads the execution of operational programs; assesses and adapts as needed to ensure quality of execution.
Leads change management activities, ensuring cross business/group coordination and logistical support for the implementation of change.
Acts as a relationship manager on assigned projects/programs and ensures alignment to overall enterprise and group goals.
Develops solutions and makes recommendations based on an understanding of the business strategy and stakeholder needs.
Participates in project/program design and provides advice & subject matter expertise to achieve required business results.
Conducts analysis required to inform strategic recommendations and considers the “big picture” when assessing whether or not a course of action is advisable in terms of the group and enterprise goals.
Collaborates with internal & external stakeholders to provide business context in the design, develop and implementation of programs & solutions.
May network with industry contacts to gather and identify competitive insights and best practices.
Breaks down strategic problems, and analyses data and information to provide insights and recommendations.
Monitors and tracks performance, and addresses any issues.
Builds change management plans of varying scope and type; leads or participates in a variety of change management activities including readiness assessments, planning, stakeholder management, execution, evaluation and sustainment of initiatives.
Identifies enablers and key issues prior to and during implementation, raises issues with stakeholders and offers solutions to resolve issues or risks that jeopardize delivery.
Operates at a group/enterprise-wide level and serves as a senior specialist resource across BMO.
Influences how teams/groups work together.
Applies expertise and thinks creatively to address unique or ambiguous situations and to find solutions to multiple, interdependent, complex problems.
Communicates abstract concepts in simple terms.
Fosters strong internal and external networks and works with and across multiple teams to achieve business objectives.
Anticipates trends and responds by implementing appropriate changes.
Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.
Take measured risks while protecting the bank by applying our Risk Management Framework in the execution of your role, in line with our Risk Culture and within our approved Risk Appetite, making sound and risk informed decisions that align to business strategy, protect assets, and adhere to applicable policy documents (Frameworks, Policies, Standards, Procedures and Supporting documents), laws and regulations.

Qualifications:

Typically 10+ years of relevant experience and post-secondary degree in related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Demonstrated leadership experience in platform strategy, technology resiliency, organizational change, frontline operations, transformation, product delivery or a related discipline.
Proven experience defining multi-year strategies and roadmaps and influencing prioritization, investment and delivery decisions in a complex organization.
Experience in financial services, frontline banking or contact centres is an asset. Prosci, ADKAR or comparable organizational change management experience is also an asset.
Seasoned expert with extensive industry knowledge.

Verbal & written communication skills - Expert.

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform
for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers
, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining
Autodesk Operations Solutions
, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations.
Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Engineering Director to lead MaintainX's Platform division. Platform owns the seven foundational teams every product engineer builds on: AI Builder, DevOps, Compliance, Testing Frameworks, Backend Frameworks, Mobile Frameworks, and SRE. This is a manager-of-managers role for someone who wants to define how a high-growth engineering org operates at scale.

What You’ll Do

Own the roadmap and operating model for Platform Engineering: set division-level priorities, manage cross-team dependencies, and translate business goals into multi-quarter platform investments.
Lead and develop a team of Software Development Managers - coaching on people development, technical judgment, and organizational effectiveness across seven teams.
Set the engineering standards every product team depends on: framework conventions, reliability targets, compliance posture, and CI/CD health.
Drive MaintainX's AI-native platform strategy - the AI Builder team's agent orchestration, tool registry, and developer environments sit in this division; your job is to ensure the org extracts real leverage from them.
Own division-level reliability: SLO definitions, incident response frameworks, on-call health, and the systemic path from incident to prevention.
Partner with the CTO and peer engineering leaders on org design, architectural decisions, and headcount planning.
Represent Platform Engineering to the business — translating infrastructure investment into engineering velocity, developer experience, and customer trust.
An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align with engineering leaders outside Québec on a daily basis.

About You

10+ years in software engineering with 5+ years in engineering leadership, including 2+ years managing managers across multiple teams.
Technical depth in at least two of: distributed systems, backend or mobile frameworks, platform engineering, reliability engineering - credible enough to make hard hiring decisions and engage in architecture reviews.
Track record of owning platform or infrastructure-focused teams at a growth-stage B2B SaaS company, with demonstrated impact on engineering velocity.
AI-forward: you set direction for teams building on LLMs and agentic workflows, and you hold your org to an AI-native standard.
Systems thinker who identifies organizational bottlenecks and eliminates them without creating new ones — you design teams, not just manage them.
Strong communicator who can represent platform complexity and tradeoffs clearly to product, finance, and executive stakeholders.

Nice To Have

Experience leading a Testing Frameworks, Quality Engineering, or Developer Productivity platform function.
Hands-on history scaling developer platforms through rapid headcount growth (Series D+).
Familiarity with CMMS, IoT, or industrial SaaS domains.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running.
Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits.
Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging.
We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

jobs.title: Trade QA Automation Engineer – Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
Discover your future at Citi

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

The Trade QA Automation Engineer – Assistant Vice President applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.

Responsibilities:

This challenging role which requires candidate to be involved in the full project lifecycle, bring in innovative smart automation suggestion to testing new developments provide the anticipated functionality, to work independently and to ensure current functionality is unaffected.
Deep hands-on expertise in tools - Selenium, BDD, TestNG, Cucumber with good concepts of Java - OOPS concepts
Good understanding of how to connect with Test Data - Selenium
Awareness in creation of Framework / knowledge in updating the scenarios.
Need exposure in usage of variables in Test Data. Knowledge in optimization of execution approaches.
Need an individual performer for completing tasks.
Capable to complete the tasks e2e on their own.
Good to have - grid implementation, cucumber customization, multi browser implementation.
Screening - Scratch in Selenium Framework. Certifications in Selenium would be an added advantage.
Good command of SQL query and Database testing - Working knowledge
Create quality test plans, test cases, scenarios & ensuring quality assurance for software development projects in various stages & managing process control as per standards.
Exposure on functional Test Automation & hybrid, keyword-driven, data-driven, Behavior Driven, Fast automation frameworks.
Hand-on experience on continuous integration will be an added advantage., Exposure to TeamCity
Hands-on experience in creating automation scripts, functions, reusable components using VB Script., Java
Good knowledge of JIRA Testing and defect Mgmt. tool with JIRA Zephyr Test Mgmt. Tool

jobs.title: Director, Commercial Strategy
jobs.description:
Job Description

Director, Commercial Strategy

Amica Support Office, Downtown Toronto

Full-Time

3 days in Office (Mon-Wed)

Amica embraces pay- for- performance compensation philosophy and offers a competitive total compensation package designed to reward performance.

Expected Salary Range : 
$124,000-155,000

Maximum Bonus Potential :
20% target bonus, that rewards exceptional performance.

Benefits:
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, disability, and employee wellness programs.

Vacation:
Generous annual vacation entitlement, aligned with company policy.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications. Candidates whose experience surpasses the expectations for this role may be eligible for compensation above the advertised range.

About Us

Amica is setting a new standard for senior living in Canada by combining unparalleled premium hospitality and amenities with expert care and support to deliver a personalized senior living experience. Committed to enriching the lives of seniors now and as their needs change, Amica offers Independent Living (IL), Assisted Living (AL) and Memory Care (MC) lifestyle options. Established in 1996, the company operates over 33 residences in British Columbia, and Ontario, with plans to continue expansion in select markets.

The Opportunity

The Director, Commercial Strategy is a senior commercial leader accountable for accelerating occupancy performance across Amica's pre-open, lease-up and occupancy-challenged residences. This role is focused directly on these priority residences - establishing commercial strategy, driving disciplined execution, removing barriers to performance, and partnering with Operations, Sales and Marketing to deliver occupancy results.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director acts as an enterprise commercial performance leader for priority residences and provides hands-on support to regional and residence teams. The role also leads selected enterprise commercial effectiveness initiatives that strengthen sales execution across the portfolio.

This position requires strong executive presence, commercial judgment, a bias for action, and the ability to move seamlessly between strategy and hands-on field execution.

What You Will Be Doing

Occupancy Performance - Pre-Open, Lease-Up & Occupancy-Challenged Residences (85%)

Own the commercial performance strategy for pre-open, lease-up and occupancy-challenged residences, with clear occupancy, sales, pipeline and conversion objectives.
Diagnose the commercial drivers of underperformance and translate them into focused residence-level action plans with clear priorities, owners, timelines and expected outcomes.
Establish and lead a rigorous performance cadence for priority residences, including regular business reviews, action tracking, escalation of barriers and executive reporting.
Partner closely with Regional Operations, residence leaders, Sales and Marketing to strengthen lead generation, pipeline health, conversion, pricing and promotional strategy, referral development and local market execution.
Provide hands-on commercial leadership to challenged residences, including direct coaching and challenge of frontline sales teams, targeted field support and decisive intervention where performance is off plan.
Own pre-open and lease-up commercial readiness and execution, ensuring each residence has the demand generation, sales capability, pipeline and market activation required to achieve occupancy milestones.

Performance Intervention & Recovery

Identify emerging occupancy risk early and mobilize targeted interventions before performance materially deteriorates.
Develop and drive 30/60/90-day recovery plans for occupancy-challenged residences, ensuring actions are practical, measurable and executed with urgency.
Challenge existing go-to-market approaches where results are not materializing. Recommend and, with the COO and functional leaders, drive decisive changes to sales resources, pricing, promotions, marketing investment, lead generation, referral strategy and local commercial execution when performance remains off plan.
Coordinate cross-functional support around priority residences and ensure teams remain focused on the few actions most likely to change occupancy trajectory.
Capture and scale successful practices from high-performing pre-open, lease-up and recovery situations across the portfolio.

Commercial Effectiveness & Field Enablement

Support sales force deployment, structure and resourcing decisions based on portfolio priorities and residence needs.
Lead sales incentive compensation strategy and execution, ensuring incentives reinforce enterprise occupancy and commercial objectives.
Partner with Sales and Marketing leaders on CRD capability, sales training and targeted development needs identified through residence performance.
Support CRM and sales process effectiveness, with a focus on field adoption, disciplined lead management and consistent execution.
Assess the effectiveness of key commercial initiatives and recommend where to continue, adjust or redirect investment.

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Hospitality, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
8-10+ years of progressive commercial, sales, operations, or revenue leadership experience, ideally in a multi-site consumer, hospitality, seniors living, real estate, or service-based organization.
Demonstrated track record of personally driving measurable revenue, sales and/or occupancy improvement, with clear examples of materially changing the trajectory of underperforming businesses or locations.
Significant experience directly leading, coaching and challenging frontline sales teams; equally comfortable working alongside teams in the field and operating in the executive room.
Experience developing and executing turnaround or performance recovery plans for underperforming locations, including diagnosing root causes and translating them into decisive commercial action.
Experience supporting new openings, market launches, lease-up or other high-growth environments is strongly preferred.

Skills & Capabilities

Commercial operator: Strong instinct for what drives occupancy and revenue, with the ability to quickly identify where performance is breaking down and what needs to change.
Execution-oriented: Moves readily from strategy to action and maintains urgency, accountability and follow-through until performance improves.
Sales leadership: Strong understanding of the full sales funnel, lead management, conversion, referral development, relationship selling, closing and sales leadership.
Performance turnaround: Able to assess an occupancy-challenged residence, establish a focused 30/60/90-day recovery plan, mobilize the right resources and drive measurable improvement.
Market and pricing acumen: Comfortable assessing competitive positioning, pricing, promotions, customer demand, local market dynamics and barriers to purchase.
Cross-functional leadership: Able to bring Operations, Sales, Marketing and other partners together around a clear commercial plan without relying solely on positional authority.
Field orientation: Willing and able to spend meaningful time in residences, working directly with GMs, CRDs and regional leaders rather than managing performance primarily from the corporate office.
Judgment and decisiveness: Knows when incremental improvement is insufficient and can recommend and drive more significant changes to sales resources, pricing, promotions, marketing investment or local execution.
Performance literacy: Comfortable using funnel, conversion, occupancy and financial information to diagnose performance and make decisions; does not need to be an analytics specialist.
Executive communication: Strong presence and ability to communicate performance, risks, actions and recommendations clearly and succinctly to senior leadership.

Working Conditions

Primarily office-based role
Regular interaction with senior leadership, operational leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders across the organization.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
May require travel to residences, or off-site business meetings and planning sessions.
May be required to work additional hours during peak business periods, including annual operating plan development, forecast cycles, and board reporting periods.
Operates in a dynamic, fast-paced environment requiring adaptability, responsiveness, and sound decision-making under pressure.

What You Can Expect From Us

A diverse and inclusive environment where individual differences are celebrated, and you’re encouraged to be your best self
Collaborative environment where we work together to succeed as a team
Learning and development opportunities to help you grow
Comprehensive benefit package including RRSP matching
Office is centrally located in the financial district, on the PATH and the TTC subway line, and provides easy access to downtown amenities
Some travel required ( Hybrid work model, in office 3 times a week

At Amica Senior Lifestyles we are passionate about working together in a supportive and inclusive environment that fosters innovation and turns ideas into action. We remain committed to creating workplaces that reflect the communities in which we operate.  We are actively seeking applicants from all religions and ethnicities, LGBTQ2s+, Black, Indigenous, racialized people, and persons with disabilities and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply for our positions. 

Requests for accommodation can be made at any stage of the recruitment process providing the applicant has met the Bona-fide requirements for the open position. Applicants need to make their requirements known when contacted.

new_jobs.title: Director of Product, AI Growth
new_jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Product, the Director of Product, AI Growth grows 1Password's new business in artificial intelligence. In this role, you own driving growth for our AI opportunities by identifying which customers we target, which outcomes we win on, and proving it with design customers. You scale growth through our go-to-market organization and through partnerships with the agent ecosystem and channel partners.

How We’re Using AI Today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

Minimum of 8 years of product management experience, including experience carrying a revenue or adoption target, with a preference for experience in security products, agentic products, or developer tools.
Experience owning the strategy for a new product area or market entry, and taking it from hypothesis to customers running in production.
Experience working directly with enterprise customers on a technical deployment, as the person accountable for the outcome, and turning what those deployments proved into a repeatable motion a sales team can run.
Experience building technology partnerships and integrations, including judging where a product should sit in a larger technology ecosystem and working with business development on commercial terms.
Technical depth to hold a credible conversation with developers and security architects about how AI agents are built, deployed, and given access to systems.
Demonstrated ability to build alignment across go-to-market and engineering teams toward a shared goal, without direct authority over either.
Demonstrated ability to make decisions and move work forward with incomplete information in a fast-changing market.
Takes ownership end to end, including the work that falls between teams.
Works AI-first: uses agents in daily work, and applies their own judgement to decisions, product taste, and customer and internal relationships.
Preferred: familiarity with agentic access products, meaning the products that give AI agents credentials and access to the systems they work in.

What You Can Expect

Growth strategy

Own the growth thesis for 1Password's AI opportunities, covering the customer segments we target, the outcomes we deliver that we win on, and the workflows we get embedded into. Revise it as evidence arrives from customers, partners, and the market.
Form and test hypotheses using customer feedback, product usage data, partner input, and market research gathered with the go-to-market, product, user experience, and product marketing teams.
Lead a weekly business review that brings the voice of the customer, field feedback, and product usage telemetry into one view, so the team can refine targets, forecast the roadmap's impact on growth, and prioritize the blockers that hold adoption back.
Identify what stops customers from adopting, and drive each blocker to a resolution with the product team that owns it.

Design customer program

Run the design customer program for new artificial intelligence opportunities, from selecting customers through to delivered outcomes.
Act as the general contractor for each design customer: the single person accountable for getting that customer deployed on 1Password for their agentic access, and for delivering the security and convenience outcomes they came for. Coordinate every team the deployment touches, and build what it requires together with a forward deployed engineering team.
Bring in solutions engineering, customer success, and product managers to help each customer reach their goal, and run feature betas with the product managers who own those features.
Turn what the program proves into the repeatable signal the company needs to scale, meaning the customer evidence, the deployment pattern, and the measured outcomes that the go-to-market and channel teams build sales plays on.
Improve the program each cycle so it reaches more design customers, raises delivery success rates and customer satisfaction, and shortens the time it takes the company to commercialize a new product.

Partnerships

Decide where 1Password should play in the customer's artificial intelligence stack to deliver the most customer value in securing agent access. Agent access can be controlled at several points in that stack, so weigh those points and choose the ones that solve the most of the customer's problem, rather than the ones we fit into most easily. Base the call on how customers run AI today and on how the industry is evolving.
Identify and pursue the partnerships that let us play at those points and that complete an end-to-end customer outcome, meaning the outcome a customer cannot reach with 1Password alone.
Work with partners to deliver integrations, and find the patterns that let us repeat an integration across similar partners instead of building each one from scratch.
Work with the business development team to structure commercial relationships that grow both companies' business and deliver value to shared customers.

Scale through the field and the developer community

Work with product enablement to build demos and enablement content that the field and our channel partners can use without your involvement.
Work with developer relations to grow adoption organically among developers, through reference architectures, sample code, and open source contributions.

Travel

Travel to design customer sites, partner meetings, and industry events approximately 10 to 20% of a given year.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $238,000 USD and $357,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $208,000 CAD and $312,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitme

new_jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering
new_jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform
for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers
, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining
Autodesk Operations Solutions
, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations.
Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Engineering Director to lead MaintainX's Platform division. Platform owns the seven foundational teams every product engineer builds on: AI Builder, DevOps, Compliance, Testing Frameworks, Backend Frameworks, Mobile Frameworks, and SRE. This is a manager-of-managers role for someone who wants to define how a high-growth engineering org operates at scale.

What You’ll Do

Own the roadmap and operating model for Platform Engineering: set division-level priorities, manage cross-team dependencies, and translate business goals into multi-quarter platform investments.
Lead and develop a team of Software Development Managers - coaching on people development, technical judgment, and organizational effectiveness across seven teams.
Set the engineering standards every product team depends on: framework conventions, reliability targets, compliance posture, and CI/CD health.
Drive MaintainX's AI-native platform strategy - the AI Builder team's agent orchestration, tool registry, and developer environments sit in this division; your job is to ensure the org extracts real leverage from them.
Own division-level reliability: SLO definitions, incident response frameworks, on-call health, and the systemic path from incident to prevention.
Partner with the CTO and peer engineering leaders on org design, architectural decisions, and headcount planning.
Represent Platform Engineering to the business — translating infrastructure investment into engineering velocity, developer experience, and customer trust.
An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align with engineering leaders outside Québec on a daily basis.

About You

10+ years in software engineering with 5+ years in engineering leadership, including 2+ years managing managers across multiple teams.
Technical depth in at least two of: distributed systems, backend or mobile frameworks, platform engineering, reliability engineering - credible enough to make hard hiring decisions and engage in architecture reviews.
Track record of owning platform or infrastructure-focused teams at a growth-stage B2B SaaS company, with demonstrated impact on engineering velocity.
AI-forward: you set direction for teams building on LLMs and agentic workflows, and you hold your org to an AI-native standard.
Systems thinker who identifies organizational bottlenecks and eliminates them without creating new ones — you design teams, not just manage them.
Strong communicator who can represent platform complexity and tradeoffs clearly to product, finance, and executive stakeholders.

Nice To Have

Experience leading a Testing Frameworks, Quality Engineering, or Developer Productivity platform function.
Hands-on history scaling developer platforms through rapid headcount growth (Series D+).
Familiarity with CMMS, IoT, or industrial SaaS domains.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running.
Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits.
Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging.
We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.
